theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Highest-scoring theme that combines a strong eligibility gate with broad participation: eligible=true, high durability_bar (0.62), breadth 0.636 (best of any top-5 theme), hurst 'mixed' but not reverting. This is the cleanest trend-following candidate in the current ranking — not because it leads (rank 2), but because its internal breadth and gate health are the strongest structural legs in the snapshot.
evidence: rotation.challenger with margin only 0.185 from leader
theses.dissent: Energy is a late-cycle/inflation-beta leadership that can reverse hard on a growth scare; its hurst is only 'mixed', and the crowding_z of 0.93 is the warmest in the top 5, so a crowded unwind could hurt even with decent breadth.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Still the rank-1 narrative leader, but I lean it only as a stay-with-trend conditional, NOT a chase. Its durability_bar sits exactly at 0.5 (mixed health) and breadth is very thin at 0.125 (the single weakest breadth of any top-10 theme), suggesting leadership is propped by a few names. The trend-gate keeps it eligible, so a modest overweight until its thin breadth confirms a handoff is a low-conviction, gate-respecting stance.
theses.dissent: With breadth of just 0.125 and durability right at the bar, this leadership is fragile and could be the weakest hand in a rotation — its r10 is negative (-0.0916) and its rank reflects residual focus, not broad strength.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Only theme in the top 5 with a clean 'trend' hurst tag and a strong 0.75 durability bar, with healthy breadth (0.6). It is crowded (z=1.61), which by guardrails means size-down caution only — not a fade. A gate-respecting overweight with a tighter horizon is defensible as long as the trend tag holds.
